Field.name: RaptorExecPath
Field.usage: Path where RAPTOR binaries are located (required)

Field.name: InputPath
Field.usage: Path where MRC stack to be aligned is located (required)

Field.name: OutputPath
Field.usage: Path where output files will be saved (required)

Field.name: Diameter
Field.usage: Diameter(s) of the markers, in pixels (required)
Field.manpage: Diameter(s) of the markers, in pixels. If you bin the image with with the -bin option to RAPTOR, the diameter has to be the one in the original image indicated by the -input entry, NOT the binned one. If the dataset has more than one kind of marker just specify the different sizes separated by commas. This entry is required.

Field.name: WhiteMarkers
Field.usage: Search for markers that are lighter than background
Field.manpage: Search for markers that have higher values than the background in the MRC stack (like quantum dots or images with inverted constrast).

Field.name: MarkersPerImage
Field.usage: Number of markers to be tracked
Field.manpage: Number of markers to be tracked. THIS IS A CRITICAL PARAMETER. If Raptor fails aligning the stack try increasing this number (it will just make the run slower). We have develop a method to try to estimate this parameter automatically. If you don't specify a number, RAPTOR will perform an estimation.

Field.name: AnglesInHeader
Field.usage: Extract tilt angles from input file header
Field.manpage: If this option is specified, RAPTOR will extract tilt angles from the header of the input stack. Otherwise, it will expect to find tilt angles in a ".rawtlt" file.

Field.name: Binning
Field.usage: Amount to bin the stack before performing alignment
Field.manpage: With this option, RAPTOR will bin the stack before performing alignment. Remember that binning affects the diameter of the markers.

Field.name: Reconstruction
Field.usage: Mode for a reconstruction to be generated by Tilt
Field.manpage: If this option is specified, RAPTOR will run IMOD's Tilt(1) program after alignment to perform the 3D reconstruction. The entry must be 0,1 or 2 to indicate the mode of the reconstruction (0 for byte, 1 for signed integer, 2 for float).

Field.name: Thickness
Field.usage: Thickness of the tomogram, if -rec option is entered

Field.name: Orient
Field.usage: Handedness of tomogram with CalTech RAPTOR: -1 for inverted handedness
Field.manpage: This option controls the handedness of a tomogram generated by the CalTech version of RAPTOR (not the one in IMOD). Enter -1 to use the PARALLEL option when running Tilt(1), which inverts handedness; the default is to use the RotateBy90 option.

Field.name: TrackingOnly
Field.usage: Just generate fiducial model, not aligned stack or reconstruction
Field.manpage: If this option is specified, RAPTOR does not generate an aligned stack or reconstruction. It just returns a fiducial model with all the tracked trajectories, like the bead tracker in IMOD.

Field.name: xRay
Field.usage: Remove strong features like straight edges to improve marker detection
Field.manpage: If the images contain strong straight line features (such as edges of a capillary sample holder) they will affect the marker detection process. Enter this option in order to remove these strong features and improve marker detection performance.

Field.name: Verbose
Field.usage: Specify how much output RAPTOR should write and keep (0-2)
Field.manpage: Specify how much output RAPTOR should write and keep: ^ 0 for minimal output. Only reconstructed volume and a minimal log file are kept ^ 1 for standard output (the default). Aligned stack is kept as well as fiducial model for IMOD and log with RAPTOR's progress. ^ 2 for debug mode. RAPTOR writes an extended output log as well as status in intermediate steps of the process. Useful to report and detect errors.

SectionHeader.name: Advanced
SectionHeader.manpage: Advanced Options ^ Use these options only if you have a good understanding of the algorithm parameters.

Field.name: MaxDistanceCandidate
Field.usage: Max distance between markers in adjacent views that could be the same marker
Field.manpage: Maximum distance between two markers in adjacent projections for them to be considered as possibly the same marker in each separate projection.

Field.name: MinNeighborsMRF
Field.tooltip: Min # of neighbors per marker for graphical correspondence model
Field.manpage: Minimum number of neighbors per marker to build the graphical model when solving for the correspondence problem.

Field.name: RollOffMRF
Field.usage: Coefficient of exponential decay to penalize farther away markers
Field.manpage: Coefficient of the exponential decay to penalize markers that are far away when establishing correspondences between projections

Field.name: Seed
Field.manpage: Seed for Pseudo-random generator; supplying this allows RAPTOR to generate identical results when run on the same data.
